summary: Aspect lookup must choose the correct regime first: same-moment pairs are canonicalized and have 11 impossible inner-planet aspects; transit-to-natal aspects are ordered and have no impossible exclusions.
body: Use this policy to prevent two different aspect regimes from being mixed. Same-moment aspects measure both bodies at one instant, so Sun, Mercury, and Venus elongation limits make 11 combinations impossible. Transit-to-natal aspects measure a moving transiting body against a fixed natal point, so every ordered planet-aspect-planet combination can occur and must not be filtered by same-moment exclusions.
definition: Lookup and validity policy for same-moment aspect files versus transit-to-natal aspect lookups.
appUsage: For same-moment aspects, canonicalize the pair using canonical_order, then skip file reads for impossible combinations.
For transit-to-natal aspects, preserve order as transiting planet -> natal point and do not apply impossible exclusions.
Do not treat missing Moon aspects as elongation exclusions; the Moon has no elongation cap in this policy.
Do not create reverse-order same-moment files. Reverse spellings are aliases of canonical keys.
note: Normalized from approved project aspect policy JSON. Source file was not copied into the repository.

classes.dedupRule: Every same-moment pair is stored and looked up under canonical_order. The reverse spelling (e.g. mercury_sun) is an ALIAS of the canonical key (sun_mercury), never a separate file. Resolve order before lookup.

same_moment.rationale: Both bodies are measured at one instant, so inner-planet elongation caps the maximum separation. The combinations below cannot occur. The app must NOT request or expect a file for them.
same_moment.moon_rule: The Moon has NO elongation limit. All five aspects to all nine other bodies are valid. A missing Moon file is a gap to fill, not an exclusion.

applies_to: daily check-in: transiting planet -> natal planet
transit_to_natal.rationale: Bodies are not co-measured. A transiting planet sweeps the entire zodiac against a fixed natal point, so it can form ANY of the five aspects to ANY natal point. The same_moment impossibilities DO NOT apply here. Do not filter transit-to-natal lookups through the impossible set.

classes.lookupContract: Pick the regime first. For same_moment: canonicalize the pair, then if (pair, aspect) is in impossible -> return no-match WITHOUT a file read. For transit_to_natal: keep order (transiting, natal), never apply the impossible set.
classes.fileNameStyle: Repository transit aspect files use hyphenated canonical same-moment ids: planet-aspect-planet. App lookup keys may use underscores internally, but must map to this file naming convention.

prohibitions: Do not apply same-moment elongation exclusions to transit-to-natal readings.
Do not request same-moment files for impossible Sun-Mercury, Sun-Venus, or Mercury-Venus aspects listed in this policy.
Do not create reverse-order duplicate same-moment files.
Do not exclude Moon aspects under the elongation rule.
weighting: This policy controls lookup validity, not interpretation weight.
Same-moment aspect files in data/transits are canonical pair files, not ordered transit-to-natal files.
Transit-to-natal interpretation support should be handled by ordered lookup logic or a separate ordered corpus if authored later.
